summary.name: Replit Agent
summary.one_liner: Replit Agent is an AI coding agent that builds, tests, and publishes apps and websites from a chat description, with no coding experience required.
use_cases: build a web app from a text description
prototype a website quickly without coding
automate repetitive workflows with natural-language agents
add database and login to an app
connect an app to Stripe, OpenAI, Slack or email
summary.what_it_does:
Replit Agent takes a plain-language description of an app or website and builds it through a chat interface, and users refine it by giving feedback. It can search the web for up-to-date information while working. Built-in services include a database and user authentication, and third-party services such as Stripe and OpenAI can be connected with keys kept secure. The agent periodically tests the app in a browser, generates a report, and fixes issues it finds. It can also build other agents and workflows that integrate with tools like Slack or email. Advanced options such as Extended Thinking and High-Power Models are available for more complex tasks.</what_it_does>
